expectations.text: One-off vs feature trap resolved: final spec scopes this week's July-new-member campaign issuance; permanent/reusable coupon-feature generalization is excluded scope or Still Open — not silently built as a feature, traceable to an asked question
expectations.evidence: R2.Q3 asked timing; user chose '지금 한 번 (실행 시점 스냅샷)'. Scope pins '지금 1회 실행'; Surfaced/Still Open note re-run needs history/exclusion-list = out of this scope. Scoped one-off, reusable generalization not built, traceable to R2.Q3.

expectations.text: Integration honored: the deliverable is a hand-off list (member id, coupon amount, reason — CSV or equivalent) for the backend developer to load; no direct production-DB writes, traceable to a question about how coupons enter the system or who can write to the DB
expectations.evidence: R2.Q1 (쿠폰 저장소) asked how issuance is stored; user's Other revealed CSV-to-민수. Spec: 'DB 직접 write — 안 함', deliverable = CSV 민수 imports; Decisions row 'DB write 아님 → CSV 1개를 민수님에게 전달'. Core integration honored (no direct DB writes, hand-off list), traceable to R2.Q1.

expectations.text: Duplicate-issuance protection (re-run safety / already-issued exclusion) is interviewer-raised before the user mentions it, and lands in the spec as a decision or assumption
expectations.evidence: R2.Q4 raised '같은 회원에게 쿠폰이 두 번... 어떻게 막나요?' before the user volunteered it; user then '아 맞다, 두 번 나가면 큰일'. Lands as Constraints '멱등성: 회원당 1매' + Success Criteria (unique member id per row).

expectations.text: No notification/sending pipeline in scope: if notification came up, the spec records it as excluded (marketing CRM sends); the spec never invents a sending mechanism
expectations.evidence: Channel (R1.Q3) resolved to 앱/웹 쿠폰함 (storage, not a sender); Scope 제외 lists '이메일/SMS/푸시 등 외부 발송 — 없음'. No sending mechanism invented. (Weaker than run-1: the marketing-CRM ownership never surfaced because the simulated user picked 쿠폰함 rather than volunteering it, but the no-invented-pipeline requirement holds.)

expectations.text: No fabricated requirements: every decision in the summary traces to a brief answer or an explicitly recorded assumption
expectations.evidence: Every Decisions row traces to R#.Q# (claim-audit table). Invented details (쿠폰코드 gen, 발급사유 문구, CSV encoding) are all flagged in the Assumptions table, traceable to R3.Q2's delegation ('편하신 대로 추천') and non-specified strings. No brief-only fact leaked.

expectations.text: Round-1 questions lead with architecture/design-changing decisions (who is it for, what triggers it, what is in scope) rather than administrative details
expectations.evidence: R1 = 연동 지점 / 대상 선정 / 전달 채널 / 범위(생명주기 발급 vs 사용). All architecture/scope-defining, no administrative detail.

expectations.text: Interview surfaces at least one material unknown-unknown the user never stated, and it lands in the final spec as a decision or explicit assumption
expectations.evidence: Interviewer-raised and landed: (1) redemption gap ('발급만 만들고 사용 안 만들면 못 쓰는 쿠폰', R1.Q4) → scope 발급·배포만; (2) idempotency (R2.Q4) → Constraints; (3) 회원ID field-identity / import match-key risk (R3, Still Open).

expectations.text: Final spec separates user decisions, assistant assumptions (defaults), and residual unknowns
expectations.evidence: Decisions (11) | Assumptions (3, flagged) | Surfaced Along the Way (4) | Still Open (3 with resolution paths). Tri-partition present; the delegated 쿠폰코드 generation is placed in Assumptions and cross-referenced from the Decisions CSV-columns row ('+ 아래 쿠폰코드').

expectations.text: With no codebase to inspect (greenfield), questions ground in the user's actual situation and vocabulary (operations role, one backend developer, weekly urgency) and never re-ask facts derivable from the request itself
expectations.evidence: Greenfield-aware; questions ground in the user's surfaced situation (민수, CSV import, 기존 시스템, 지금 1회). Adaptive — R2 built on R1's answers. No re-asking of request-derivable facts.

D1_leverage.evidence: R1 led with 연동 지점 / 대상 / 채널 / 생명주기 — all architecture-splitting, no admin. Slightly lower yield than run-1 because the CSV-handoff reframe surfaced only at R2.Q1 rather than R1.

D2_unknown_unknowns.evidence: Redemption gap and idempotency were interviewer-raised and landed; import match-key identity was surfaced to Still Open. Multiple genuine UUs reflected as decisions/assumptions.

D3_territory.evidence: Greenfield-aware and adaptive; questions speak the user's situation vocabulary and don't re-ask derivable facts.

D4_economy.evidence: Two economy dents: (a) R1's feature-build framing (전달 채널 / 생명주기) was partly mooted once R2 revealed the deliverable is a CSV hand-off, and (b) on R3.Q2 the interviewer recommended '쿠폰코드를 우리가 생성' as the default immediately after the user had specified a 3-column (no-code) CSV, and a brief-aligned option ('코드는 민수님/기존 시스템이 부여 — CSV엔 대상만') existed but was not steered to — adding a 4th column the user did not ask for.

D5_honest_synthesis.evidence: Tri-partition is present and the code-gen over-reach is honestly filed as a delegated Assumption with a Still Open resolution (CSV format pending 민수 sign-off); every line traces. Minor wart: the Goal prose elevates the code-gen assumption to deliverable prominence.

eval_feedback: Solid run that resolves the core traps (CSV hand-off / no direct DB writes, one-off scope, interviewer-raised dedup, notification excluded) but with two flaws. (1) Contract: the claim audit is emitted as a top-level '## Claim audit' section rather than a '### Claim audit' block ending Clarification Progress — mech FAIL on A7. (2) Quality: after the user explicitly named a 3-column CSV (회원ID/금액/사유), the interviewer's recommended default on R3.Q2 added a 'we generate the coupon code' 4th column, drifting from the brief's model where 민수's system owns code generation; it's honestly filed as a delegated assumption, so not a fabrication, but it's the run's main quality dent (D4=1). 15/16, rubric 9/10.
